text:
sam_infra: heads-up — we got gpu-node-07 back from DC-3 support with ECC spikes during transit. I ran quick checks, but want a short reproducible soak/stress plan before returning to the pool. can @maya_sre / @eli_hw weigh in on what we should run and for how long?

maya_sre: yep. thanks. can you paste the dmesg / nvidia-smi output you saw? also node label (zone/serial) so we can track. my default is minimum 12h targeted GPU stress + 24h light soak if flaky history.

sam_infra: node: gpu-node-07 (zone: dc3-rack7, serial: GPN-7-211). dmesg excerpt: 
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, PID=4321, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 1234.568000] nvidia-modeset: Dismissed error, recovering
```
and nvidia-smi: 
```
GPU 0: Tesla-A100 40GB, ECC errors (volatile): 12
GPU 1: Tesla-A100 40GB, ECC errors (volatile): 0
```
I only saw the spike on GPU0. temps were 72C.

eli_hw: Xid 31 + ECC spike = suspicious but not definitive. Could be power transient or flaky PCIe lane. Repro strategy: 1) isolate GPU0 from node-level noise (drain node), 2) run targeted CUDA mem/warmup + long-running kernel that exercises memory (e.g., gemm stress), 3) run PCIe stress (if available) and collect continuous dmesg and ECC counters. If it reproduces within 6-12h we mark as flaky. If not, put into 72h light soak under load.

zoe_tester: concrete commands i use locally: 
```bash
# drain to avoid user disruption
kubectl drain gpu-node-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
# continuous monitoring (new tty)
watch -n 10 nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,POWER,TEMPERATURE
# GPU stress (6h)
stress-ng --gpu 1 --matrix 0 --timeout 6h --metrics-brief &
# model-style KV cache stress, runs many small seqs
python tools/kv_cache_stress.py --gpus 1 --seq-len 1024 --iters 5000
```
additionally stream dmesg: `sudo journalctl -f -u kernel` and dump `/var/log/kern.log` every 5 minutes.

ci-bot: [soak-run-template v2] started for gpu-node-07 by sam_infra. run_id=soak-2026-03-18-011. logging -> s3://redwood-infra-soak/gpu-node-07/soak-2026-03-18-011/

nina_platform: decision criteria to standardize (proposal):
- PASS: no new Xid > 0 for 24h under stress, ECC volatile counter increase <= 3 over baseline, average GPU temp < 80C, no memory corruption from kernel tests.
- SOFT-FLAG: Xid appears once but only during PCI stress; record and extend soak to 72h.
- FAIL: repeated Xid (>=3) or ECC increase > 10 in 24h or kernel oops. Mark for RMA and replace.

maya_sre: good. additions: collect pcie link state (`lspci -vv -s 65:00`) and `nvidia-bug-report.sh` at the start and end. keep telemetry collection on (prom push every 30s). Also run `memtest86` overnight if removal/maintenance window allows.

sam_infra: about capacity — i'll drain and move pods off. we have spare headroom in dc3 but might need to shift jobs to dc1 for scheduled conv tasks. i'll annotate the node with `infra/soak=running` and an expected restore time.

eli_hw: logging tips: collect `dmesg -T > dmesg.before.txt` then run the stress and at fail `dmesg -T > dmesg.after.txt`. grab `/sys/class/drm/card*/device/` telemetry and ECC counters: `cat /sys/class/drm/card0/device/ecc_volatile` (path varies by driver). also take a physical run of `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC -l 60` to append to a file.

zoe_tester: if it fails, label the node `infra/rma=todo` and create ticket `HW-RMA <serial>` with attached logs and run_id. if it passes, we do staged rejoin: 1) uncordon, 2) run ten small GPU jobs from perf-suite (smoke) and check latencies, 3) put back into autoscaler pool.

sam_infra: plan accepted. kicking off: drain now, start stress (6h), if nothing then extend to 24h light soak. I'll paste updates to this thread and attach the soak artifacts link. thanks all. :thumbsup:

maya_sre: thanks sam — ping us if Xid reproduces. if it does, hold node out of rotation until HW confirms.

ci-bot: soak-run completed (6h phase). artifacts: s3://redwood-infra-soak/gpu-node-07/soak-2026-03-18-011/phase1.tar.gz. summary: no new Xid in phase1, ECC volatile increased by 1 on gpu0, max temp 75C. moving to extended 24h soak.

sam_infra: noted. extending to 24h. will update with final verdict by 1799004322.
